acceptanceCriteria: A check, or a recorded decision not to add one, covers requirement definitions placed outside a spec's `## Requirements` section, so later amendments cannot silently fall out of OCM.
CAL-V0-073 is defined inside `## Requirements` of docs/specs/corvint-tasks-agent-leases-v0.md, and a requirementsFromBlob test shows OCM enumerates it.
body: Reported by the V1-0788 lane on 2026-10-04 and confirmed from source at origin/main a62e1917e0087722f439fb448ba12a12ce7627df. internal/lrfrepo/ocm.go:565 enumerates requirements only from the `## Requirements` section and stops at the next level-two heading. In docs/specs/corvint-tasks-agent-leases-v0.md, `## Requirements` spans lines 104-1316, but CAL-V0-073 is defined at line 1604 under `## V1-0751 CREATE payload template amendment`. OCM therefore does not see CAL-V0-073, while REQUIREMENTS.tsv and the traceability checks do. Expected: every defined requirement is enumerated by OCM. Actual: CAL-V0-073 is omitted. The in-flight issue lanes (V1-0755, V1-0786, V1-0788 and others) place new CAL requirements inside `## Requirements` for this reason.
